**Answer:**  
The sculpture most frequently cited as the quintessential work of the 19th‑century is **Auguste Rodin’s “The Thinker.”** Created between 1902 and 1903, it captures the era’s shift toward expressive realism and has become an enduring symbol of artistic contemplation worldwide.
